relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: Anti-CGRP mAbs and BoNT-A both resulted in a mean MHD reduction at 6 (-11.5 and -7.2 days, respectively; unadjusted mean difference -4.3; 95%CI -6.6 to -2.0; p = 0.0003)

relationships.subject: OnabotulinumtoxinA
relationships.evidence_quote: BoNT-A indirectly inhibits the release of neurotransmitters by C fibers by cleaving the SNAP-25 protein

key_findings: In chronic migraine, anti-CGRP mAbs reduced monthly headache days more than BoNT-A at 12 months (-11.9 vs -7.6 days; adjusted difference -6.2).
Safety was comparable; no serious adverse events.
